purpose: Authoring registry for the model pipeline: where each asset's source lives, which authority owns it, how its runtime export is produced and what bytes were approved. This is the build-side companion to the shipped contract (S02): a manifest describes what the renderer may load, this file describes how the bytes are made. Do not duplicate approved hashes here - they are read from the record named per asset, so the two cannot drift.

policy.note: Ordinary Git. LFS is adopted only when a single file crosses the threshold, and then atomically (attributes + build fetching + fresh-clone check).

budget_policy.note: Advisory class budgets, set below the loader's hard failure (render/authored_mesh.py: 12,000 triangles, 10,000 vertices, 2,000,000 bytes per file) so a build can weigh them: the pipeline reports W_TRIANGLE_BUDGET when an asset crosses its own. Until this decision these numbers were the loader's caps, which can never fire.

blender.note: The pipeline never hardcodes an application path in code. Resolution order: --blender, $STAR_ARMADA_BLENDER, `blender` on PATH, then the per-platform candidates below. Add your install here rather than editing the tool.

tree_hygiene.note: Autosaves and temporary renders must never be committed. Raw capture runs belong outside the repository.

packaging.note: Runtime exports and manifests ship; editable sources and authoring tools do not.

provenance.note: Written by build-model/export-model, committed with the change. A provenance entry that does not describe the bytes on disk is a validation error.

contract_validation.note: D2: validate-models IS the S02 contract validator, not a second opinion. If it is absent the pipeline fails with E_NO_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR rather than passing on its own checks alone.
